strings.en: Karura{n}"Keeh, keh-keh-keh! Keeh, keh-keh!{n} Keeh, keh-keh-keh! Keeh, keh-keh!"{n}"Keeh, keh-keh-keh! Keeh, keh-keh!{n} Keeh, keh-keh-keh! Keeh, keh-keh!{n} Keeh, keh-keh-keh! Keeh, keh-keh!"{n}{n}"Karuraaaaaaaaaaaa!"{n}{n}"In the seas! The mountains! The earth!{n} The skies! The rivers! The forests!{n} In fire! In water! In wind!"{n}"All you hundreds of millions of wandering souls, writhing and struggling!"{n}{n}"Now gather into my body and open a feast of frenzy and ruin!"{n}"Upon the fools who spend their days in gloom in the world of the living, those walking corpses!"{n}"Share out curses! And ruin!{n} And your own suffering!"{n}"Come forth! My souls!{n} Ukonki!{n} Sakonki!"

strings.jp: {kata}カルラ{n}{hira}「さあ! おろかなる 人間どもの{n} 大地に 毒の雨を ふらすがよい!」
strings.en: Karura{n}"Now! Rain poison down upon the land of those foolish humans!"

strings.jp: {kata}カルラ{n}{hira}「人間どもには{n} 毒の沼地が おにあいだ!」
strings.en: Karura{n}"A poison swamp is just what humans deserve!"

strings.jp: {kata}カルラ{n}{hira}「{kata}ケ{hira}ー{kata}ケッケッ{hira}!{n} {kata}ケ{hira}ー{kata}ケッケッ{hira}!」{n}「{kata}オレ{hira}様の 野望が{n} わからぬ やつなど{n} ただの 虫けらだ!」{n}「えんま! 伐折羅! 夜叉!{n} {kata}アジャセ{hira}! {sub:CE}!{n} 風神! 雷神! しこめ!」{n}「酒香童子! 浦島! 金太郎!{n} そして 自分の おろかさにも{n} 気づかぬ あわれな {sub:A0}!」{n}「すべての 虫けらどもよ!{n} みにくく 死ぬがいい!{n} {kata}ケ{hira}ー{kata}ケッケッ{hira}! {kata}ケ{hira}ー{kata}ケッケッ{hira}!」
strings.en: Karura{n}"Keeh, keh-keh!{n} Keeh, keh-keh!"{n}"Anyone who can't grasp my grand ambition is nothing but an insect!"{n}"Enma! Basara! Yasha!{n} Ajase! Ashura!{n} Fujin! Raijin! Shikome!"{n}"Shuko Doji! Urashima! Kintaro!{n} And pitiful Momotaro, who can't even see his own foolishness!"{n}"All you insects!{n} Die an ugly death!{n} Keeh, keh-keh! Keeh, keh-keh!"

strings.jp: {kata}カルラ{n}{hira}「{kata}ケ{hira}ー{kata}ッケッケッ{hira}!{n} {sub:A0}! 聞こえるか?」{n}「毒の沼地の 気分は どうだ?{n} もっと おもしろいものを{n} いまから 見せてやる!」{n}「右魂鬼! 左魂鬼!{n} おろか者たちに{n} とどめを さしてやれ!」
strings.en: Karura{n}"Keeh, keh-keh-keh!{n} Momotaro! Can you hear me?"{n}"How do you like the poison swamp?{n} Now I'll show you something even more amusing!"{n}"Ukonki! Sakonki!{n} Finish off these fools!"

strings.jp: {kata}カルラ{n}{hira}「{kata}ケ{hira}ー{kata}ッケッケッ{hira}!{n} {kata}ケ{hira}ー{kata}ッケッケッ{hira}!」{n}「どうだ! {sub:A0}!{n} {kata}オレ{hira}様の力を 見たか!」{n}{n}「{kata}オレ{hira}様に さからう者は{n} これから いつでも{n} こういう目に あうのだ!」
strings.en: Karura{n}"Keeh, keh-keh-keh!{n} Keeh, keh-keh-keh!"{n}"How's that, Momotaro!{n} Have you seen my power?!"{n}{n}"From now on, anyone who defies me will always end up like this!"
